caption: The drawing depicts a side profile of a horse, standing on a horizontal rod with another short vertical rod supporting it. The horse is shown in a running posture with its front right leg and rear left leg extended forward, while the other two legs are extended backward. The horse's body is colored primarily in shades of brown, with areas of yellow, red, and purple, creating a mottled effect. The mane is depicted as a series of pointed, triangular shapes colored dark brown, extending along the back of the neck. The tail is also dark brown and flows straight back. The background is a plain, light beige or off-white color, with a large black area filling the upper left corner. There are a few small, scattered black dots on the background. The artist's name, "Selma Sandler," is written in small print in the lower right corner.
title: Weather Vane
